categories.main_business_segments: Great Microwave Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of integrated circuit chips and microsystems. Its main products include RF transceiver chips, high-speed high-precision ADC/DAC chips, power management chips, microsystems, and modules. The company also provides technical services related to these products, primarily serving special industry fields such as data links, electronic countermeasures, wireless communication terminals, next-generation radios, phased array communications, and electronic system power supply.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs fully forward design R&D technology, covering a full chain of 'chip-module-system' with multi-product line synergy. Core technologies include wide/narrowband signal compatible large dynamic range receiver channel design, low spurious low noise transmitter channel design, multi-chip synchronization, radiation-hardened low-power transceiver design, broadband digital beamforming, radiation-hardened power management chips, and 3D heterogeneous integration for RF microsystems. Manufacturing is outsourced under a fabless model, with wafer fabrication and packaging/testing contracted to specialized foundries.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily manufacturers of special industry equipment, including national defense and aerospace sectors, such as subsidiaries of the China National Defense Science and Industry Group and major research institutes. The company also serves commercial low-earth orbit satellite markets, including satellite internet and digital phased array radar systems. Its products are core components in multiple national defense projects and commercial satellite constellations.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are concentrated in China, with headquarters and R&D centers located in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province. It collaborates with domestic leading research institutes and aerospace enterprises. There is no significant international sales or operations disclosed.
categories.supply_chain_position: Operating as a fabless semiconductor design company, Great Microwave Technology is positioned upstream in the supply chain, focusing on chip design and development. It outsources wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to foundries and subcontractors, while directly managing product design, quality control, and sales to downstream customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment, dedicating over 51% of revenue to research and development, focusing on advancing RF transceiver chips, high-precision ADC/DAC, power management chips, and microsystems. Strategic emphasis is on radiation-hardened and low-power designs for satellite communication, digital phased array systems, and expanding product coverage in low-earth orbit commercial satellites. It also aims to enhance product modularity and standardization, accelerate innovation cycles, and strengthen talent development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of integrated circuit products and microsystems to customers in special industries. The company mainly uses a direct sales model with some sales through distributors. Technical services are also sold directly. Pricing is negotiated based on product performance, delivery schedules, and customer relationships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international leaders such as Texas Instruments and Analog Devices in the analog and RF chip markets. While its scale is smaller, its products have reached domestic and international advanced performance levels, especially in specialized fields like satellite communication and defense. It holds a strong domestic position as a core supplier for national defense and commercial satellite projects, with significant barriers to entry for competitors due to high technical and qualification requirements.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 303 million, an 8.04% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 17.85 million, a 75.37% decrease due to increased R&D investment and credit impairment losses. The company has total assets of about RMB 2.24 billion and equity of RMB 2.14 billion. It maintains a high R&D intensity and is in a growth phase with expanding product lines and market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Great Microwave Technology emphasizes its fully forward design approach, high integration of chip-module-system solutions, and advanced radiation-hardened, low-power, and high-performance RF and power management chips. Its products enable miniaturization and lightweight satellite payloads, provide high reliability under harsh environments, and offer competitive performance comparable to international leaders. The company’s deep customer understanding and customization capabilities create significant competitive barriers and long-term stable customer relationships.
